words.enDefinition: The airport hall for passengers before departure

examples.en: I met my classmate in the departure hall before we found the airline counter.
examples.zh: 我们找到航空公司柜台前，我先在「出发大厅」见了同学。

examples.en: The bus stopped outside the departure hall where the airline signs were easy to see.
examples.zh: 公交车停在「出发大厅」外，航空公司的指示牌在那里很容易看到。

collocations: a sign in the departure hall

words.enDefinition: A map of the areas inside a terminal

examples.en: I opened the terminal map to find the closest entrance to our airline's counter.
examples.zh: 我打开「航站楼地图」，查哪个入口离我们航空公司的柜台最近。

examples.en: The terminal map showed an indoor path from the bus stop to check-in.
examples.zh: 「航站楼地图」标出了一条从公交站到值机区的室内路线。

collocations: find something on the terminal map

words.enDefinition: A doorway leading into the passenger terminal

examples.en: My flatmate waited by the terminal entrance while I helped load the bags.
examples.zh: 我帮着搬行李时，室友在「航站楼入口」旁等着。

examples.en: The terminal entrance closest to the bus stop was on the same level.
examples.zh: 离公交站最近的「航站楼入口」就在同一层。

collocations: a sign at the terminal entrance

words.enDefinition: A waiting area for passengers before their flight

examples.en: We picked seats in the departure lounge where we could hear announcements clearly.
examples.zh: 我们在「候机厅」选了几个能听清广播的座位。

examples.en: I met a classmate in the departure lounge after we checked in separately.
examples.zh: 我们各自办完值机后，我在「候机厅」见到了一位同学。

words.enDefinition: A terminal corridor or hall serving multiple gates

examples.en: The concourse had several gates and two long rows of seats along the windows.
examples.zh: 「候机廊区」里有几个登机口，沿窗摆着两长排座位。

examples.en: We followed the signs along the concourse until we could see our gate.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「候机廊区」照指示牌走，直到看到自己的登机口。

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a particular terminal

examples.en: I texted the terminal number to my flatmate before we left the house.
examples.zh: 我们出门之前，我发了条消息把「航站楼编号」告诉室友。

examples.en: The terminal number in the app matched the number printed on the airport sign.
examples.zh: 应用里的「航站楼编号」和机场指示牌上印的一样。

collocations: a terminal number on the itinerary

words.enDefinition: The departure area or listing for international flights

examples.en: The sign for international departures pointed upstairs from the bus entrance at the airport.
examples.zh: 从机场的公交入口进来，「国际出发」的指示牌指向楼上。

examples.en: We followed international departures on the signs until we reached the airline counters.
examples.zh: 我们跟着「国际出发」的指示牌走，到了航空公司柜台。

words.enDefinition: The departure area or listing for flights within a country

examples.en: I looked for domestic departures on the signs after leaving the airport bus.
examples.zh: 我下了机场公交之后，在指示牌上找「国内出发」。

examples.en: The domestic departures area was on another level from the international counters we passed.
examples.zh: 「国内出发」区和我们经过的国际航班柜台不在同一层。

words.enDefinition: The terminal space where passengers check in

examples.en: The check-in area was quiet when our group arrived with all our luggage.
examples.zh: 我们一行人带着行李到达时，「值机区」很安静。

examples.en: We chose a meeting point just outside the check-in area near the escalator.
examples.zh: 我们选了个碰面地点，就在自动扶梯旁的「值机区」外面。

words.enDefinition: A staffed airport counter operated by an airline

examples.en: I showed the email to the agent at the airline counter before checking in.
examples.zh: 值机前，我把邮件给「航空公司柜台」的工作人员看。

examples.en: The airline counter for our flight was at the end of the row.
examples.zh: 我们这趟航班的「航空公司柜台」在整排柜台的尽头。

words.enDefinition: A row of counters used for checking in

examples.en: The sign gave a check-in row for each airline in the departure hall.
examples.zh: 出发大厅的牌子上标出了每家航空公司对应的「值机柜台所在排」。

examples.en: I checked the letter above the check-in row before joining my classmate.
examples.zh: 我看了「值机柜台所在排」上方的字母，再去找同学。

collocations: a sign above a check-in row

words.enDefinition: Passenger check-in using a machine without a desk agent

examples.en: I used self-service check-in to print a boarding pass at the airport.
examples.zh: 我在机场用「自助值机」打印了登机牌。

examples.en: A volunteer showed me where the self-service check-in machines were near the entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看入口附近的「自助值机」机器在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: Checking in for a flight over the internet

examples.en: I completed online check-in from my laptop before leaving the student residence.
examples.zh: 离开学生宿舍之前，我用笔记本办好了「网上值机」。

examples.en: The email said online check-in was available for this flight on the airline's website.
examples.zh: 邮件说这趟航班可以在航空公司的网站上办理「网上值机」。

words.enDefinition: To register as ready to travel on a flight

examples.en: I needed to check in for a flight before meeting my friend downstairs.
examples.zh: 我得先「办理航班值机」，再去楼下找朋友。

examples.en: Can I check in for a flight with my booking reference at this machine?
examples.zh: 我可以在这台机器上用预订编号「办理航班值机」吗？

collocations: use a kiosk to check in for a flight
arrive to check in for a flight
check in for a flight online

words.enDefinition: The latest time check-in is accepted

examples.en: I checked the check-in cutoff in the airline's message before booking my airport bus.
examples.zh: 订机场公交之前，我在航空公司的消息里查了「值机截止时间」。

examples.en: The check-in cutoff was listed under a different heading from the boarding time.
examples.zh: 「值机截止时间」列在一个与登机时间不同的栏目下。

collocations: the check-in cutoff for a flight

words.enDefinition: A code identifying a particular scheduled flight

examples.en: The agent asked for my flight number before looking up the booking.
examples.zh: 工作人员先问我的「航班号」，然后查找预订记录。

examples.en: I checked the flight number because two flights had the same destination that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上有两趟航班飞往同一个地方，所以我核对了「航班号」。

collocations: a flight number on the board

words.enDefinition: A place for dropping passengers off at the airport

examples.en: My roommate waited at the airport drop-off area with both of our suitcases.
examples.zh: 室友带着我们两个人的行李箱在「机场下客区」等我。

examples.en: The airport drop-off area was just outside the doors for departures at this terminal.
examples.zh: 「机场下客区」就在这座航站楼出发区的大门外面。

collocations: arrive at the airport drop-off area
signs for the airport drop-off area
an airport drop-off area near departures

words.enDefinition: The airline that runs a particular flight

examples.en: The operating carrier was listed in small print below the flight in my email.
examples.zh: 邮件在航班下方用小字标出了「实际承运航司」。

examples.en: I checked which operating carrier was named before looking for the check-in area.
examples.zh: 找值机区前，我先查看了列出的「实际承运航司」是哪家。

collocations: the operating carrier of a flight

words.enDefinition: One flight sold under codes by multiple airlines

examples.en: I saw two different flight numbers for the same codeshare flight on my itinerary.
examples.zh: 我在行程单上看到，同一趟「代码共享航班」有两个不同的航班号。

examples.en: The airline counter explained which number to look for because it was a codeshare flight.
examples.zh: 因为是「代码共享航班」，航司柜台的工作人员告诉我要找哪个航班号。

collocations: check in for a codeshare flight

words.enDefinition: Workers assisting airline operations on the ground

examples.en: The ground staff directed us toward the row for checking in our bags.
examples.zh: 「地勤人员」把我们指到了办理行李托运的那排柜台。

examples.en: I asked the ground staff where our group should wait before boarding.
examples.zh: 我问「地勤人员」，我们一行人登机前应该在哪里等。

words.enDefinition: An airline worker who assists passengers at check-in

examples.en: The check-in agent looked up both bookings when we arrived at the counter.
examples.zh: 我们到柜台时，「值机人员」查了两份预订记录。

examples.en: I asked the check-in agent whether my classmate and I could sit together.
examples.zh: 我问「值机人员」能不能让我和同学坐在一起。

collocations: a check-in agent at the counter

words.enDefinition: A code that identifies a passenger's booking

examples.en: I entered my booking reference to open the reservation on the airline's website.
examples.zh: 我输入「预订编号」，打开了航空公司网站上的订票记录。

examples.en: The check-in agent asked for the booking reference from my original email.
examples.zh: 值机人员请我提供原始邮件中的「预订编号」。

words.enDefinition: A number identifying an individual issued ticket

examples.en: I found my ticket number on the receipt attached to the airline email.
examples.zh: 我在航空公司邮件所附的凭据上找到了「机票号码」。

examples.en: The agent checked the ticket number after opening the booking at the counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员在柜台打开预订记录后，核对了「机票号码」。

words.enDefinition: An airline ticket recorded electronically

examples.en: I saved my e-ticket so I could find my flight details later.
examples.zh: 我保存了「电子机票」，以便之后查航班详情。

examples.en: The e-ticket was attached to the confirmation email I received from the travel office.
examples.zh: 旅行服务处发来的确认邮件附有「电子机票」。

words.enDefinition: The passenger name recorded for the reservation

examples.en: I checked the name on the booking before going to the airline counter.
examples.zh: 去航空公司柜台前，我核对了「预订记录上的姓名」。

examples.en: The agent asked whether the name on the booking included my middle name.
examples.zh: 工作人员问「预订记录上的姓名」是否包含我的中间名。

collocations: check the name on the booking
confirm the name on the booking
a typo in the name on the booking

words.enDefinition: A difference between names on two records

examples.en: The agent noticed a name mismatch and asked me to show the original email.
examples.zh: 工作人员发现「姓名不一致」，请我出示原始邮件。

examples.en: I asked the help desk about a name mismatch before going to check-in.
examples.zh: 去值机前，我向服务台问了「姓名不一致」的问题。

collocations: a name mismatch in the booking

words.enDefinition: An inspection of a passenger's passport

examples.en: The airline arranged a passport check at the counter for passengers on this flight.
examples.zh: 航空公司安排这趟航班的乘客在柜台接受「护照核对」。

examples.en: I put my passport away when the agent finished the passport check at the desk.
examples.zh: 工作人员在柜台完成「护照核对」后，我把护照收了起来。

collocations: a passport check at the counter

words.enDefinition: An official document used to identify a traveler

examples.en: The form asked for the type of travel document I would be carrying.
examples.zh: 表单询问我会携带哪种「旅行证件」。

examples.en: I showed the agent the travel document I had named on the booking form.
examples.zh: 我向工作人员出示了预订表单上填写的「旅行证件」。

words.enDefinition: A message showing that check-in was completed

examples.en: I saved the check-in confirmation after the page showed my flight and seat details.
examples.zh: 页面显示航班和座位详情后，我保存了「值机确认信息」。

examples.en: My check-in confirmation appeared in the app shortly after I finished the form.
examples.zh: 我填完表单后不久，「值机确认信息」就出现在应用里。

words.enDefinition: The seat allocated to a particular passenger

examples.en: I checked my seat assignment because my classmate and I wanted to sit together.
examples.zh: 因为我和同学想坐在一起，我看了自己「分配到的座位」。

examples.en: The seat assignment in the app had a different row from my original selection.
examples.zh: 应用里「分配到的座位」和我最初选的座位不在同一排。

words.enDefinition: A line of passengers waiting to check in

examples.en: The check-in queue started near the pillar in the middle of the departure hall.
examples.zh: 「值机队伍」从出发大厅中间的柱子旁开始排。

examples.en: I joined the check-in queue after finding my booking confirmation on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上找出预订确认邮件后，就排进了「值机队伍」。

words.enDefinition: A seat between two other seats in a row

examples.en: I was assigned a middle seat while my classmate sat in another row.
examples.zh: 我分到了一个「中间座位」，同学则坐在另一排。

examples.en: The agent said the only seat still showing on my screen was a middle seat.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，我屏幕上唯一还显示的座位是「中间座位」。

collocations: a middle seat in the back

words.enDefinition: Seats directly next to each other

examples.en: We asked whether adjacent seats were available for the two of us.
examples.zh: 我们问有没有两个「相邻座位」给我们。

examples.en: The seat map showed two adjacent seats near the front of the plane.
examples.zh: 座位图显示飞机前部有两个「相邻座位」。

words.enDefinition: A seat directly behind a partition in an aircraft

examples.en: The agent offered a bulkhead seat in the first row of that cabin section.
examples.zh: 工作人员提供了客舱该区第一排一个「紧靠隔板后方的座位」。

examples.en: I asked where the bulkhead seat was before accepting the new seat assignment.
examples.zh: 接受新分配的座位之前，我问「紧靠隔板后方的座位」在哪儿。

collocations: a bulkhead seat near the front

words.enDefinition: A notice that a seat will be allocated at the gate

examples.en: The app showed “Seat assigned at gate” where I normally saw my seat number.
examples.zh: 应用在通常显示座位号的地方写着「座位在登机口分配」。

examples.en: My boarding pass said “Seat assigned at gate,” so I asked the airline agent.
examples.zh: 我的登机牌上写着「座位在登机口分配」，我就去问了航空公司工作人员。

collocations: a boarding pass marked “Seat assigned at gate”
a message saying “Seat assigned at gate”

words.enDefinition: A document used to board a particular flight

examples.en: I checked the gate number on my boarding pass before leaving the airline counter.
examples.zh: 离开航空公司柜台前，我看了「登机牌」上的登机口号码。

examples.en: The agent handed me a boarding pass and pointed toward the security checkpoint.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「登机牌」递给我，然后指了指安检口。

words.enDefinition: A boarding pass displayed on a mobile device

examples.en: I opened the mobile boarding pass on my phone before joining the group.
examples.zh: 加入队伍前，我在手机上打开了「手机登机牌」。

examples.en: My friend checked the boarding time on the mobile boarding pass while we waited.
examples.zh: 等候时，朋友查看了「手机登机牌」上的登机时间。

words.enDefinition: A boarding pass printed or issued on paper

examples.en: I kept the paper boarding pass in the front pocket of my backpack.
examples.zh: 我把「纸质登机牌」放在背包前袋里。

examples.en: The agent printed a paper boarding pass when my phone ran out of power.
examples.zh: 我的手机没电后，工作人员给我打印了一张「纸质登机牌」。

words.enDefinition: To print another copy of a boarding pass

examples.en: I asked the airline agent to reprint a boarding pass that had torn.
examples.zh: 登机牌撕破了，我请航空公司工作人员帮我「重新打印一张登机牌」。

examples.en: Can I reprint a boarding pass at the same machine I used earlier?
examples.zh: 我能在之前用过的同一台机器上「重新打印登机牌」吗？

collocations: ask someone to reprint a boarding pass
need to reprint a boarding pass
reprint a boarding pass at the counter

words.enDefinition: A machine-readable code on a boarding pass

examples.en: The gate agent asked me to show the boarding pass barcode on my phone.
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员让我出示手机上的「登机牌条码」。

examples.en: The boarding pass barcode was printed below the flight number on the slip.
examples.zh: 纸条上的「登机牌条码」印在航班号下方。

words.enDefinition: To present a boarding pass for electronic reading

examples.en: The sign asked you to scan your boarding pass at the gate reader.
examples.zh: 告示请旅客在登机口的读卡器上「扫描登机牌」。

examples.en: Where should you scan your boarding pass when the gate staff call your group?
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员叫到你的组时，你该去哪儿「扫描登机牌」？

collocations: scan your boarding pass at the gate
ask you to scan your boarding pass
ready to scan your boarding pass

words.enDefinition: An identity document that displays the holder's photograph

examples.en: The airline message said to have a photo ID ready at the counter.
examples.zh: 航空公司的消息说，到柜台时要备好「带照片的身份证明」。

examples.en: I checked that my photo ID was in the same pouch as my ticket.
examples.zh: 我确认「带照片的身份证明」和机票放在同一个袋子里。

words.enDefinition: A bag a passenger takes into the cabin

examples.en: I kept my book in my carry-on bag so I could read while waiting.
examples.zh: 我把书放在「随身登机行李」里，这样候机时可以看。

examples.en: The agent asked which bag was my carry-on bag before she tagged the suitcase.
examples.zh: 工作人员给行李箱贴标签前，问我哪件是「随身登机行李」。

collocations: place a carry-on bag in the cabin

words.enDefinition: Baggage handed over for transport in the hold

examples.en: I checked that both suitcases appeared as checked baggage in the airline's app.
examples.zh: 我确认航空公司应用把两个行李箱都列为「托运行李」。

examples.en: The email had a separate section listing our checked baggage for the trip.
examples.zh: 邮件单独用一栏列出了我们这趟行程的「托运行李」。

words.enDefinition: To hand a bag over for transport in the hold

examples.en: Can I check a bag at this counter if I already have my boarding pass?
examples.zh: 我已经有登机牌了，可以在这个柜台「托运一件行李」吗？

examples.en: I decided to check a bag because I was bringing books from my course.
examples.zh: 我带了课上的书，就决定「托运一件行李」。

collocations: check a bag at the airport

words.enDefinition: To hand a bag over for the hold at the gate

examples.en: The agent said we could gate-check a bag if we wanted more room on board.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，如果我们想在机上多腾些空间，可以「在登机口托运行李」。

examples.en: I asked what label I would receive if I had to gate-check a bag.
examples.zh: 我问如果需要「在登机口托运行李」，会拿到什么标签。

collocations: ask someone to gate-check a bag

words.enDefinition: A record that checked baggage was accepted

examples.en: The check-in agent gave me a baggage receipt after my suitcase went onto the belt.
examples.zh: 我的行李箱上了传送带以后，值机人员给了我一张「托运行李凭条」。

examples.en: I kept the baggage receipt with my boarding pass in the same folder.
examples.zh: 我把「托运行李凭条」和登机牌放在同一个文件夹里。

collocations: a baggage receipt for each checked bag

words.enDefinition: An airport point for handing over checked baggage

examples.en: We went to bag drop after printing the tags by the airline counters.
examples.zh: 我们在航空公司柜台旁打印了标签，然后去了「托运行李交运处」。

examples.en: The sign for bag drop was above the second row of check-in machines.
examples.zh: 「托运行李交运处」的牌子在第二排值机机器上方。

words.enDefinition: A machine or area for checking bags independently

examples.en: I used the self-service bag drop after printing my label at the terminal.
examples.zh: 在航站楼打印标签后，我用了「自助托运点」。

examples.en: The volunteer pointed out the self-service bag drop beside the staffed airline counter.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看人工航空柜台旁的「自助托运点」。

collocations: staff near the self-service bag drop

words.enDefinition: The latest time a checked bag is accepted

examples.en: I checked the bag drop deadline before deciding when to leave my flat.
examples.zh: 我先查了「托运交付截止时间」，再决定几点出门。

examples.en: The bag drop deadline appeared next to the flight details in the airline email.
examples.zh: 航空公司的邮件在航班详情旁列出了「托运交付截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: A scale used to weigh bags

examples.en: The baggage scale was near the entrance to the self-service bag drop.
examples.zh: 「行李秤」在自助托运点的入口附近。

examples.en: I watched the baggage scale display while my suitcase was on the belt.
examples.zh: 行李箱放上传送带时，我看着「行李秤」的显示屏。

collocations: put a bag on the baggage scale

words.enDefinition: To measure how much your bag weighs

examples.en: The volunteer pointed out where you could weigh your bag before reaching the counter.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我们看，到柜台前可以在哪里「给行李称重」。

examples.en: Can you weigh your bag here or do you need to wait for the agent?
examples.zh: 你能在这里「给行李称重」吗，还是得等工作人员？

collocations: weigh your bag at the counter
ask you to weigh your bag
use a scale to weigh your bag

words.enDefinition: The checked baggage covered under a ticket's terms

examples.en: My checked baggage allowance was different from my classmate's because we booked different fares.
examples.zh: 我和同学订了不同的票价类型，所以「托运行李额度」也不同。

examples.en: The booking email showed the checked baggage allowance below each passenger's name.
examples.zh: 预订邮件在每位乘客姓名下方显示了「托运行李额度」。

collocations: look up your checked baggage allowance

words.enDefinition: The cabin baggage covered by a ticket's terms

examples.en: I asked about the carry-on allowance before choosing which bag to bring.
examples.zh: 决定带哪个包之前，我问了「随身行李额度」。

examples.en: The carry-on allowance for our flight was shown separately from the checked baggage details.
examples.zh: 我们这趟航班的「随身行李额度」和托运行李详情分开显示。

collocations: a carry-on allowance on the booking

words.zhGloss: 小件随身物品（登机行李）
words.enDefinition: A small bag counted separately from regular cabin baggage
acceptedZhAnswers: 小件随身物品（登机行李）

examples.en: The booking showed a personal item on its own line under baggage.
examples.zh: 预订信息在行李一栏里单列了「小件随身物品」。

examples.en: I asked whether this little laptop bag counted as a personal item.
examples.zh: 我问这个小电脑包能不能算作「小件随身物品」。

words.enDefinition: A frame used to check a bag's size

examples.en: The baggage sizer beside the counter had the airline's name printed on it.
examples.zh: 柜台旁的「行李尺寸框」上印着航空公司的名字。

examples.en: I saw a baggage sizer near the gate but did not need to use it.
examples.zh: 我在登机口附近看到一个「行李尺寸框」，不过没用到。

collocations: a bag fits in the baggage sizer
a baggage sizer at the gate

words.enDefinition: The length, width and height of a bag

examples.en: I checked the bag dimensions on the label before buying the suitcase for my trip.
examples.zh: 为这趟行程买行李箱前，我看了标签上的「行李尺寸」。

examples.en: The form asked for bag dimensions when I added my equipment case to the booking.
examples.zh: 我把器材箱加到预订记录时，表单要求填写「行李尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: The maximum weight allowed for a piece of baggage

examples.en: The airline's page displayed the baggage weight limit next to my fare type.
examples.zh: 航空公司页面在我的票价类型旁显示了「行李重量上限」。

examples.en: I asked the agent where the baggage weight limit appeared in my booking.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员，预订记录上哪里能看到「行李重量上限」。

collocations: the baggage weight limit for this fare

words.enDefinition: One separate bag, suitcase or similar item

examples.en: I had one piece of luggage to check and a small backpack to carry.
examples.zh: 我有「一件行李」要托运，还有个小背包随身带。

examples.en: The volunteer counted each piece of luggage before we loaded the airport bus.
examples.zh: 我们把东西搬上机场公交之前，志愿者清点了「每件行李」。

words.enDefinition: A suitcase with a rigid outer shell

examples.en: I chose a hard-shell suitcase because I was bringing a few framed prints.
examples.zh: 我要带几幅装裱过的印刷品，就选了一个「硬壳行李箱」。

examples.en: The hard-shell suitcase stood upright beside my friend's bag at the bag drop.
examples.zh: 「硬壳行李箱」竖放在行李托运处朋友的包旁边。

words.enDefinition: A suitcase with flexible fabric sides

examples.en: The soft-sided suitcase had a front pocket for the papers I needed at check-in.
examples.zh: 这个「软壳行李箱」有个前袋，可以放我值机需要的文件。

examples.en: My flatmate brought a soft-sided suitcase instead of her usual rigid case.
examples.zh: 室友这次带的是「软壳行李箱」，没带平时那个硬壳箱。

collocations: the pocket of a soft-sided suitcase

words.enDefinition: A suitcase that can be rolled on wheels

examples.en: I pulled my wheeled suitcase along the concourse while my friend checked the gate.
examples.zh: 朋友查看登机口时，我沿着候机廊区拉着「带轮行李箱」走。

examples.en: The handle of my wheeled suitcase caught on the edge of the luggage trolley.
examples.zh: 我的「带轮行李箱」拉杆卡在行李推车边上。

words.enDefinition: A long bag for carrying clothes on hangers

examples.en: I packed my jacket in a garment bag for the university awards ceremony.
examples.zh: 为了参加学校的颁奖仪式，我把外套装进「衣物防皱袋」。

examples.en: I asked the airline counter where the garment bag went during the flight.
examples.zh: 我问航空公司柜台，这个「衣物防皱袋」在飞行途中会放在哪里。

collocations: pack a suit in a garment bag

words.enDefinition: A small fabric case for organizing suitcase contents

examples.en: I put my socks in a packing cube to keep the suitcase organized.
examples.zh: 我把袜子放进「行李分装袋」，让行李箱里更整齐。

examples.en: My packing cube was easy to find when I opened the suitcase at check-in.
examples.zh: 值机时我打开行李箱，很容易就找到了「行李分装袋」。

words.enDefinition: A strap fastened around a suitcase

examples.en: The bright luggage strap made it easy to recognize my suitcase in the queue.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的「行李箱捆扎带」让我一下就在队伍里认出了自己的行李箱。

examples.en: I tightened the luggage strap after closing the suitcase beside the check-in counter.
examples.zh: 我在值机柜台旁合上行李箱后，把「行李箱捆扎带」勒紧了。

words.enDefinition: A small lock used to secure luggage

examples.en: My luggage lock was in the same pouch as the spare bag tags.
examples.zh: 我的「行李锁」和备用行李牌放在同一个袋子里。

examples.en: I bought a luggage lock from the shop in the departure hall.
examples.zh: 我在出发大厅的商店买了一个「行李锁」。

collocations: a suitcase with a luggage lock

words.enDefinition: A removable cover that protects a suitcase exterior

examples.en: I chose a bright luggage cover so I could recognize my suitcase quickly.
examples.zh: 我选了一个颜色鲜艳的「行李箱保护套」，这样能一下认出自己的箱子。

examples.en: The luggage cover had an opening for the handle at the top.
examples.zh: 「行李箱保护套」顶部有个开口，可以露出提手。

words.enDefinition: A handle that extends and retracts in sections

examples.en: I pulled out the telescoping handle before rolling my suitcase toward the counter.
examples.zh: 我把「可伸缩拉杆」拉出来，再拖着行李箱走向柜台。

examples.en: The telescoping handle on my new suitcase slid down before I put it on the belt.
examples.zh: 我把新行李箱放上传送带前，「可伸缩拉杆」滑下去了。

collocations: a suitcase with a telescoping handle

words.enDefinition: A small cart used to move airport luggage

examples.en: We put both suitcases on a baggage trolley outside the terminal doors.
examples.zh: 我们在航站楼门外把两个行李箱放上了「行李手推车」。

examples.en: I returned the baggage trolley after my classmate finished checking in his bags.
examples.zh: 同学托运完行李后，我还了「行李手推车」。

words.enDefinition: Baggage heavier than the accepted weight limit

examples.en: The agent told me which counter dealt with overweight baggage at this airport.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，这座机场哪个柜台办理「超重行李」。

examples.en: My email showed the airline's charge for overweight baggage under the other fees.
examples.zh: 我的邮件在其他费用下方列出了航司的「超重行李」收费。

words.enDefinition: Baggage handled under separate arrangements because of its type

examples.en: The airline page listed sports equipment under special baggage beside the standard bag options.
examples.zh: 航空公司的页面把体育器材归入「特殊行李」，与普通行李选项并列。

examples.en: I asked whether my instrument case counted as special baggage before going to the counter.
examples.zh: 去柜台之前，我问乐器箱算不算「特殊行李」。

words.enDefinition: A counter that accepts unusually large checked baggage

examples.en: The agent asked me to take the case to the oversize baggage desk.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我把箱子带到「超尺寸行李柜台」。

examples.en: We waited by the oversize baggage desk while a friend fetched the equipment case.
examples.zh: 朋友去拿器材箱时，我们在「超尺寸行李柜台」旁边等。

collocations: go to the oversize baggage desk
signs for the oversize baggage desk

words.enDefinition: An item easily broken or damaged

examples.en: I told the agent that I had a fragile item inside the case.
examples.zh: 我告诉工作人员，手提箱里有一件「易碎物品」。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to describe the fragile item before printing the baggage label.
examples.zh: 柜台工作人员先让我说明「易碎物品」是什么，再打印行李标签。

collocations: a bag containing a fragile item

words.enDefinition: A machine that prints labels for checked baggage

examples.en: The baggage tag printer near the airline counter had run out of paper.
examples.zh: 航空公司柜台旁的「行李标签打印机」用完了纸。

examples.en: The volunteer pointed out the baggage tag printer beside the row of scales.
examples.zh: 志愿者给我指了指一排行李秤旁的「行李标签打印机」。

collocations: load paper into a baggage tag printer

words.enDefinition: A charge for carrying baggage on a flight

examples.en: I asked what the baggage fee covered before paying at the airline counter.
examples.zh: 我在航空公司柜台付钱前，问了「行李费用」包含哪些项目。

examples.en: The booking showed the baggage fee separately from the fare for each passenger.
examples.zh: 预订记录把「行李费用」和每位乘客的票价分开显示。

words.enDefinition: A bag in addition to those already included

examples.en: My flatmate added an extra bag to the booking before we left.
examples.zh: 我们出门前，室友在预订记录里加了「额外一件行李」。

examples.en: I asked whether the extra bag would appear on the same confirmation email.
examples.zh: 我问「额外一件行李」会不会出现在同一封确认邮件里。

words.enDefinition: Baggage that exceeds the allowance on a ticket

examples.en: The agent explained the charge for excess baggage after checking my fare.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对我的票价类型后，解释了「超额行李」如何收费。

examples.en: The email listed excess baggage separately from the baggage included with the ticket.
examples.zh: 邮件把「超额行李」和机票包含的行李分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Baggage paid for in advance of drop-off

examples.en: I showed the email confirming prepaid baggage when I reached the airline counter.
examples.zh: 到航空公司柜台时，我出示了确认「行李费用已预付」的邮件。

examples.en: The app showed prepaid baggage below the names of the people on the booking.
examples.zh: 应用在预订乘客姓名下方显示了「已预付费用的行李」。

words.enDefinition: To add one bag for the hold to a booking

examples.en: I used the airline's app to add a checked bag before our airport bus arrived.
examples.zh: 机场公交到站前，我用航空公司的应用「加购了一件托运行李」。

examples.en: Can I add a checked bag at the counter after doing online check-in?
examples.zh: 我办完网上值机后，可以在柜台「加购一件托运行李」吗？

collocations: choose to add a checked bag
use an app to add a checked bag
add a checked bag to a booking

words.enDefinition: To take an earlier label off a bag

examples.en: The agent asked me to remove an old tag from my suitcase handle.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我从行李箱提手上「取下旧行李标签」。

examples.en: I stopped to remove an old tag before attaching the new one at bag drop.
examples.zh: 在托运处贴上新标签前，我停下来「取下旧行李标签」。

collocations: ask someone to remove an old tag
stop to remove an old tag
remove an old tag from a suitcase

words.enDefinition: The conveyor taking checked baggage from the counter

examples.en: The agent lifted my suitcase onto the check-in belt after checking the new tag.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对新标签后，把我的行李箱放上了「值机托运行李传送带」。

examples.en: I waited beside the check-in belt until the suitcase moved away from the counter.
examples.zh: 我等在「值机托运行李传送带」旁，直到行李箱离开柜台。

collocations: place a bag on the check-in belt
a suitcase on the check-in belt

words.enDefinition: To fasten an identifying label to baggage

examples.en: The volunteer showed me where to attach a bag tag to each suitcase.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看，每个行李箱应该在哪里「贴上行李标签」。

examples.en: I paused to attach a bag tag after printing it at the machine.
examples.zh: 我用机器打出标签后，停下来「贴上行李标签」。

collocations: ask how to attach a bag tag
attach a bag tag to a suitcase
help someone attach a bag tag

words.enDefinition: Material wrapped around luggage for protection

examples.en: The shop near the counter offered luggage wrap for cases with exposed straps.
examples.zh: 柜台旁的店提供「行李缠绕包装膜」，用来包裹绑带露在外面的箱子。

examples.en: The luggage wrap on my classmate's suitcase was clear enough to see the handle.
examples.zh: 同学行李箱上的「行李缠绕包装膜」是透明的，能看见提手。

collocations: wrap a suitcase in luggage wrap

words.enDefinition: To take items out and pack the bag again

examples.en: The agent offered a nearby table where you could repack your bag if necessary.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，如有需要，可以在旁边那张桌子上「重新收拾行李」。

examples.en: Where can you repack your bag if the zip cannot close all the way?
examples.zh: 如果拉链拉不到头，可以在哪儿「重新收拾行李」？

collocations: use a table to repack your bag

words.enDefinition: Security checks for passengers and baggage at an airport

examples.en: We met on the other side of airport security before walking toward our gate.
examples.zh: 我们通过「机场安检」后在另一边碰面，再一起往登机口走。

examples.en: The airline counter pointed us toward airport security after we checked in the suitcases.
examples.zh: 我们托运完行李箱后，航空公司柜台的工作人员给我们指了「机场安检」的方向。

words.enDefinition: A point where security checks take place

examples.en: I followed the signs to the security checkpoint after leaving the check-in area.
examples.zh: 离开值机区后，我沿着指示牌走向「安检口」。

examples.en: My friend waited at the security checkpoint while I found my boarding pass.
examples.zh: 我找登机牌时，朋友在「安检口」等着。

words.enDefinition: Inspection of passengers or belongings for security purposes

examples.en: The airport map showed where security screening took place before the gate area.
examples.zh: 机场地图标出了走到登机口区域之前在哪里进行「安全检查」。

examples.en: My classmate asked an officer where we should wait for security screening.
examples.zh: 同学问安检人员，我们应该在哪里等候「安全检查」。

words.enDefinition: A designated line and area for security screening

examples.en: An officer directed us to a screening lane with an open entrance.
examples.zh: 安检员引导我们走进一条入口开着的「安检通道」。

examples.en: The sign above the screening lane was hard to see from the queue.
examples.zh: 排队时很难看清「安检通道」上方的牌子。

words.enDefinition: An officer carrying out security screening

examples.en: I asked a screening officer which desk could answer my question.
examples.zh: 我问一位「安检人员」，哪个服务台能回答我的问题。

examples.en: The screening officer pointed toward the tray I had left by the belt.
examples.zh: 「安检人员」指了指我落在传送带旁的托盘。

collocations: a screening officer at the checkpoint

words.enDefinition: A tray for belongings during screening

examples.en: I checked the security tray again before leaving the area by the belt.
examples.zh: 我离开传送带旁的区域前，又看了一下「安检托盘」。

examples.en: An officer handed my classmate a security tray from the stack on the table.
examples.zh: 安检人员从桌上的一摞托盘里拿了个「安检托盘」给我同学。

words.enDefinition: A line of people waiting for security screening

examples.en: We joined the security queue together after the agent printed both boarding passes.
examples.zh: 工作人员打出两张登机牌后，我们一起排进了「安检队伍」。

examples.en: I saw my classmate near the end of the security queue by the sign.
examples.zh: 我在牌子旁的「安检队伍」队尾附近看见了同学。

collocations: the end of the security queue

words.enDefinition: X-ray screening of a passenger's baggage

examples.en: The airport sign used the words baggage X-ray beside an image of a suitcase.
examples.zh: 机场指示牌在行李箱图案旁写着「行李X光检查」。

examples.en: The officer told me where to wait while the bag went through baggage X-ray.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，行李接受「行李X光检查」时要在哪儿等。

words.enDefinition: A device that senses the presence of metal

examples.en: The picture of a metal detector was on the sign above the checkpoint.
examples.zh: 安检口上方的牌子上画着一台「金属探测器」。

examples.en: I asked the officer which line led to the metal detector beside the belt.
examples.zh: 我问安检员哪条队伍通向传送带旁的「金属探测器」。

collocations: a metal detector at the checkpoint

words.enDefinition: A device used in security to screen people

examples.en: The officer pointed out the body scanner when I asked where to stand.
examples.zh: 我问该站哪儿时，工作人员指给我看「人体安检扫描仪」。

examples.en: The sign beside the body scanner explained where passengers should ask for assistance.
examples.zh: 「人体安检扫描仪」旁的告示写明了旅客需要帮助时到哪里询问。

collocations: a body scanner at the airport
a sign beside the body scanner

words.enDefinition: An extra check beyond the initial screening

examples.en: An officer told me my bag needed additional screening and showed me where to wait.
examples.zh: 安检员说我的行李需要「进一步安检」，并指给我等待的位置。

examples.en: I stayed near the marked area while my classmate waited for additional screening.
examples.zh: 同学等候「进一步安检」时，我留在标出的区域附近。

words.enDefinition: A check of the contents of a bag

examples.en: I told the officer the bag was mine before the bag inspection began.
examples.zh: 「行李检查」开始前，我告诉安检员那个包是我的。

examples.en: The sign showed where to wait if staff requested a bag inspection.
examples.zh: 告示说明了工作人员要求「行李检查」时去哪里等。

words.enDefinition: To take back the personal items you brought

examples.en: The sign asked you to collect your belongings before leaving the screening area.
examples.zh: 告示请你在离开安检区前「拿回随身物品」。

examples.en: Where do you collect your belongings after your tray reaches the other side?
examples.zh: 托盘到另一边后，你在哪里「拿回随身物品」？

collocations: collect your belongings from the tray
ask you to collect your belongings

words.enDefinition: A polite request to open a bag

examples.en: The officer said, “Please open your bag,” and pointed to the suitcase beside me.
examples.zh: 安检员说：「请打开您的包」，同时指了指我身旁的行李箱。

examples.en: I heard “Please open your bag” and asked the officer which bag she meant.
examples.zh: 我听到「请打开您的包」，就问安检员说的是哪一件。

words.enDefinition: A question about where an item should go

examples.en: I asked, “Where should I put this?” while holding the tray beside the belt.
examples.zh: 我拿着托盘站在传送带旁，问：「这东西放哪里？」

examples.en: I asked, “Where should I put this bag?” when the officer pointed toward the table.
examples.zh: 安检员指向桌子时，我问：「这个包放哪里？」

words.enDefinition: To step out of the main line or path

examples.en: The officer asked me to move to the side while I found my boarding pass.
examples.zh: 安检员让我「移到旁边」找登机牌。

examples.en: Could you move to the side so the people behind you can pass?
examples.zh: 你能「移到旁边」吗，让身后的人过去。

collocations: ask someone to move to the side
move to the side of the lane
move to the side to let people pass

words.enDefinition: A question confirming who owns a bag

examples.en: The officer asked, “Is this your bag?” while pointing to the blue case.
examples.zh: 安检员指着蓝色的箱子问：「这是您的包吗？」

examples.en: I heard “Is this your bag?” and turned to see what the officer was holding.
examples.zh: 我听到「这是您的包吗」，转身看安检员拿着什么。

words.enDefinition: To pass through the airport's security checks

examples.en: We had time to go through security before meeting the rest of the group.
examples.zh: 和队伍其他人碰面前，我们还有时间「过安检」。

examples.en: The agent pointed toward the east side where we could go through security.
examples.zh: 工作人员指了指东边，我们可以在那里「过安检」。

collocations: get ready to go through security
go through security at the airport

words.enDefinition: On the secured side of an airport terminal

examples.en: The map showed an airside café near the gate where my classmate was waiting.
examples.zh: 地图标着登机口附近有一家「安检后候机区内的」咖啡馆，同学就在那边等。

examples.en: The airport map showed an airside walkway between the lounge and our gate.
examples.zh: 机场地图标出了「安检后区域内」一条连接候机厅和登机口的步行通道。

words.zhGloss: 机场安检前的公共区域
words.enDefinition: On the public side of an airport terminal
acceptedZhAnswers: 机场安检前的公共区域

examples.en: I picked a landside meeting point for my friend before we went through security.
examples.zh: 「过安检前的公共区域」里，我选了一个和朋友碰面的地点。

examples.en: The landside café was near the doors where the airport bus dropped us off.
examples.zh: 「安检前公共区域里的」咖啡馆在机场公交让我们下车的门口附近。

words.enDefinition: The space around a gate for waiting or boarding

examples.en: We sat in the gate area while a staff member updated the screen.
examples.zh: 工作人员更新屏幕时，我们坐在「登机口区域」等着。

examples.en: The gate area was nearly empty when our group arrived after the security check.
examples.zh: 我们一行人安检后到达时，「登机口区域」几乎没人。

words.enDefinition: An airport point passengers pass through to board

examples.en: We walked to the boarding gate after checking the number on the screen.
examples.zh: 我们核对了屏幕上的号码，然后走向「登机口」。

examples.en: The boarding gate was at the far end of the concourse near the windows.
examples.zh: 「登机口」在候机廊区的另一头，靠近窗户。

collocations: a boarding gate on the lower level

words.enDefinition: The identifying number or code of a boarding gate

examples.en: I checked the gate number before sending my classmate a message about where to meet.
examples.zh: 告诉同学去哪儿碰面之前，我核对了「登机口编号」。

examples.en: The gate number appeared at the top of the screen above our flight details.
examples.zh: 「登机口编号」显示在屏幕顶部的航班详情上方。

collocations: a gate number on the boarding pass

words.enDefinition: The time when boarding is scheduled to begin

examples.en: I checked the boarding time before looking for my friend in the terminal.
examples.zh: 在航站楼里找朋友之前，我查了「登机时间」。

examples.en: The airline put the boarding time next to the gate number on my pass.
examples.zh: 航空公司把「登机时间」列在登机牌的登机口编号旁边。

collocations: a boarding time on the pass

words.enDefinition: The time a gate stops accepting boarding passengers

examples.en: The gate closing time appeared on another line below the boarding time.
examples.zh: 「登机口关闭时间」另外列在登机时间下方一行。

examples.en: I checked the gate closing time before taking a seat near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我先看了「登机口关闭时间」，才在入口附近找了个座位。

collocations: arrive before the gate closing time

words.enDefinition: An announcement that boarding has started

examples.en: The gate screen showed “Now boarding” when we came back from the café.
examples.zh: 我们从咖啡馆回来时，登机口屏幕显示「正在登机」。

examples.en: I heard “Now boarding” over the loudspeaker and checked the flight number.
examples.zh: 我听到广播说「正在登机」，就核对了航班号。

collocations: now boarding at the next gate

words.enDefinition: The last announcement asking passengers to board

examples.en: We heard the final boarding call while walking toward the gate after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我们往登机口走时听到了「最后登机广播」。

examples.en: The agent made a final boarding call before removing the boarding sign.
examples.zh: 工作人员撤掉登机指示牌之前播了「最后登机广播」。

collocations: the final boarding call for a flight

words.enDefinition: A notice that boarding is no longer open

examples.en: The screen showed “Boarding closed” even though people were still standing nearby.
examples.zh: 尽管附近还有人站着，屏幕已经显示「登机已结束」。

examples.en: I saw “Boarding closed” beside another flight number on the gate's display.
examples.zh: 我在登机口屏幕的另一个航班号旁边看到了「登机已结束」。

words.enDefinition: A marked lane passengers use to approach the gate

examples.en: The gate agent opened another boarding lane after calling the next group.
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员叫了下一组后，又开了一条「登机排队通道」。

examples.en: I stayed outside the boarding lane until the staff asked our group to enter.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我们这一组进去之前，我一直待在「登机排队通道」外。

words.enDefinition: A group of passengers assigned to board together

examples.en: I checked my boarding group before joining the line beside the gate.
examples.zh: 走进登机口旁的队伍前，我确认了自己的「登机组别」。

examples.en: The boarding group on my pass was different from my classmate's group.
examples.zh: 我登机牌上的「登机组别」和同学的不一样。

words.enDefinition: The sequence in which passengers are invited to board

examples.en: The sign listed the boarding order above the desk where staff were scanning passes.
examples.zh: 牌子在工作人员扫描登机牌的柜台上方列出了「登机顺序」。

examples.en: The boarding order was shown on the screen beside the flight number.
examples.zh: 「登机顺序」显示在屏幕上的航班号旁。

words.enDefinition: The option to board before some other passengers

examples.en: The app showed whether priority boarding was included with the fare I had chosen.
examples.zh: 应用显示了我选的票价类型是否包含「优先登机」。

examples.en: I asked at the counter where the priority boarding line would start.
examples.zh: 我在柜台问「优先登机」的队伍从哪里开始排。

words.zhGloss: 常规分组前的登机安排
words.enDefinition: Boarding offered before the regular groups are called
acceptedZhAnswers: 常规分组前的登机安排

examples.en: The agent made a preboarding announcement before calling the first regular group.
examples.zh: 工作人员在叫第一批常规登机组之前，播报了「常规分组前的登机安排」。

examples.en: My friend asked about preboarding when she arranged assistance with the airline.
examples.zh: 朋友向航空公司安排协助服务时，询问了「常规分组前的登机安排」。

words.enDefinition: A boarding stage for passengers traveling with children

examples.en: The gate agent called family boarding before inviting the next group to line up.
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员先通知「携儿童家庭登机」，再请下一组排队。

examples.en: I saw family boarding listed near the top of the gate screen.
examples.zh: 我看到登机口屏幕靠上位置列出了「携儿童家庭登机」。

words.enDefinition: To stay until your group is invited to board

examples.en: The announcement asked you to wait for your group before approaching the gate.
examples.zh: 广播请大家「等候叫到自己的登机组」，再走向登机口。

examples.en: Do you have to wait for your group here or beside the other sign?
examples.zh: 你得在这里「等候叫到自己的登机组」，还是在另一块牌子旁等？

collocations: ask you to wait for your group
wait for your group at the gate
wait for your group to be called

words.enDefinition: An airline worker who assists passengers at a gate

examples.en: The gate agent showed me which line to join with my boarding pass.
examples.zh: 「登机口工作人员」指给我看，拿着登机牌该排哪条队。

examples.en: I asked the gate agent whether my friend was in the same boarding group.
examples.zh: 我问「登机口工作人员」，朋友的登机组别是不是和我的一样。

collocations: a gate agent at the podium

words.enDefinition: An enclosed walkway from the terminal to an aircraft

examples.en: We walked along the jet bridge after the agent scanned our boarding passes.
examples.zh: 工作人员扫完我们的登机牌后，我们沿着「登机廊桥」走。

examples.en: There was a short wait on the jet bridge before we reached the plane.
examples.zh: 到飞机前，我们在「登机廊桥」上等了一小会儿。

words.enDefinition: Stairs used to enter an aircraft from the ground

examples.en: The staff pointed toward the boarding stairs when we stepped off the airport bus.
examples.zh: 我们从机场接驳车下来时，工作人员指向了「登机梯」。

examples.en: I waited at the bottom of the boarding stairs until the line moved.
examples.zh: 队伍开始移动前，我在「登机梯」底下等着。

collocations: the bottom of the boarding stairs

words.enDefinition: A gate where passengers take a bus to the aircraft

examples.en: The bus gate was downstairs at the end of the newer concourse.
examples.zh: 「接驳车登机口」在楼下，位于较新的候机廊区尽头。

examples.en: I asked why our flight was listed at a bus gate on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问为什么屏幕显示我们这趟航班在「接驳车登机口」。

collocations: a sign for the bus gate

words.enDefinition: Help provided to passengers who need support boarding

examples.en: My classmate asked the airline about boarding assistance before going to the gate.
examples.zh: 同学在去登机口之前问了航空公司有关「登机协助」的问题。

examples.en: The gate agent showed us where to wait for boarding assistance that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，登机口工作人员告诉我们该在哪里等候「登机协助」。

words.enDefinition: An instruction asking passengers to go to the gate

examples.en: The announcement said we could proceed to the gate after the screen was updated.
examples.zh: 广播说，屏幕更新后我们可以「前往登机口」。

examples.en: I heard “Proceed to the gate” and checked which flight the announcement named.
examples.zh: 我听到「请前往登机口」，就确认了一下广播里说的是哪个航班。

collocations: ask passengers to proceed to the gate
proceed to the gate for boarding
a notice saying “Proceed to the gate”
